about.p1: Born and raised in Yaoundé, I work here today as a software developer. I started my studies at the IUT of Ngaoundéré, where I earned a DUT in software engineering with honours, then continued at the University Institute of Sciences, Technologies and Ethics, where I graduated with a professional Bachelor's degree with highest honours, ranking first in my class.
about.p2: In 2024, I joined BkSquare SARL as a research intern to design a facial-recognition system. The project was validated and adopted in-house, and the company hired me at the end of the internship. Since then, I have been working there as a developer and IT manager.
about.p3: Alongside my academic and professional journey, I have invested in several community initiatives: coordinating IT communities in the Adamaoua and Far-North regions from 2023 to 2024, chairing the IUT Ngaoundéré Computer Club in 2021–2022, and giving private tutoring in mathematics and computer science. These experiences strengthened my communication, teaching and teamwork skills — qualities I also apply in the way I design and write code.
about.signature: "What if a few lines of code could change the world?"
